name: Piecewise-Constant PDF Sampling
aliases: Original Piecewise Constant Opacity Importance Sampling
definition: Samples points from a piecewise-constant probability density function defined by bin endpoints t and weights w_logits.
summary: Piecewise-Constant PDF Sampling generates sample coordinates by inverting a step-wise cumulative distribution function constructed from softmax-normalized weights, ensuring samples respect learned probability mass.
